xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4558: Conversation open sends the whole transcript: bound the initial window and page older history

plan.title: Conversation open sends the whole transcript: bound the initial window and page older history
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: The window, paging and resume share one cursor contract (WI-1) and one client cache-merge model (WI-11); shipping any one without the others leaves either an unbounded path or a timeline that cannot reach older history, and the 1 MiB budget is not reachable without tool-body elision. The surface spans contracts, server read paths, the frontend timeline, tests and docs (four OKF files live in a separate repo), so it exceeds the 25-file projection while staying one feature. Items are sliced finely and DAG-ordered so slots stay small.

narratives.Problem: Opening a conversation sends its whole parsed transcript to the browser over HTTP (GET /api/conversations/:name/messages) and the WS subscribe (first snapshot event), and every WS resubscribe resends it. Long transcripts are several MB; #3778 showed full snapshots on resubscribe starving the domain event stream into a reconnect loop.
narratives.Proposal: Bound every cold open (HTTP and WS, all harnesses, conversations and agent sessions) to the newest 75 timeline rows or ~960 KiB of entries with a cursor and hasOlder flag; add ?before=<cursor>&limit= paged reads loaded when the timeline scrolls near the top and prepended without moving the view; elide tool bodies over 4 KB to a size hint and load them on expand via tool-body routes; let a WS resubscribe send resume {afterSequence, openIds, transcript} so the server sends only new or newly settled rows; enforce the budget with a >5 MB synthetic-transcript test. Full design: .pan/drafts/PAN-4558.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Eliding message text: a single newest entry larger than the budget is still sent whole.
- Searching unloaded rows or omitted tool bodies with Ctrl+F.
- Paging in TerminalPanel, DirectoryTranscript or SessionTranscript; they keep the full agents-route response.
- Changing transcripts on disk, parser output, the message-locator route, or #3778 direction 3 (watchdog fairness).
- Adding any new persistent cache or on-disk state.
- Raising scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt caps.

autoDecisions.summary: Window unit is timeline rows over the merged messages+workLog order (75 rows) with a 983,040-byte entry budget leaving 64 KiB for metadata under a 1 MiB payload budget.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks for about 75 timeline rows or about 1 MiB; windowing the two arrays separately would interleave wrongly at the old edge, and a metadata allowance makes the 1 MiB assertion hold mechanically.

autoDecisions.summary: Cursor is the timeline key [createdAt, sequence, kind, id] of the oldest contiguous entry, encoded as JSON.
autoDecisions.rationale: Byte offsets do not map to entries because parsers sort and merge tool blocks; the key matches the frontend's sort and is a total order.

autoDecisions.summary: WS resume (issue AC3, #3778 direction 1) uses afterSequence + openIds + transcript id, with a windowed reset snapshot as the fallback.
autoDecisions.rationale: Every parser except prime-agent assigns per-line sequences from file start; open entries are the only rows that change in place, and the transcript id detects a replaced file.

autoDecisions.summary: Tool bodies over 4 KB are elided on every windowed, paged and WS payload and loaded through new tool-body routes; window=all and the agents route without params stay full and unelided.
autoDecisions.rationale: Export and three agent-route hosts keep working unchanged while every open path stays within budget.

autoDecisions.summary: Include the agents conversation route (window=initial, before, tool-body) even though the issue names only the conversations route.
autoDecisions.rationale: Agent panels receive windowed WS snapshots and elided bodies, so they need the same paging and body routes to reach older history and expand tool rows.

autoDecisions.summary: Docs item edits the OKF bundle at /home/eltmon/Projects/overdeck-knowledge and commits there directly.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires the OKF conversation-ui and data-flow concepts; PAN-4312 updated them the same way (commit 0641353).

autoDecisions.summary: Keep one plan with sizeJustification instead of splitting into sibling issues.
autoDecisions.rationale: All six issue ACs live on this issue and share one cursor contract and client merge model; splitting would ship paths that are bounded but cannot page, or resume without windows.

items.title: Add the shared conversation window contract to packages/contracts

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1. In rpc.ts add WorkLogEntry.resultBytes/bodyOmitted, ConversationWindow {cursor: NullOr(String), hasOlder, transcript?}, ConversationResume {afterSequence, openIds, transcript}, window? on the messages ConversationEvent member and on ConversationResponse, resume? on SubscribeConversationMessagesRpc payload. Export from index.ts; mirror fields in frontend chat-types.ts.

items.title: Given cursors for two entries with equal createdAt, compareTimelineKeys orders them by sequence, then message before work entry, then id, and the conversation-window.test.ts cases for this pass.
decodeTimelineCursor returns null for 'x', '[1,2]' and a tuple whose third element is not 0 or 1, and returns the original key for any encodeTimelineCursor output.
hasToolResult returns true for an entry with resultBytes 5000 and no result, and false for an entry with neither.

The SubscribeConversationMessagesRpc payload schema accepts {conversationName, resume: {afterSequence, openIds, transcript}} and the messages event schema accepts a window field, verified by rpc.test.ts decode cases.

Add the server window, page and resume selection module

metadata.parallelSafeReason: Touches only two new files; parallel-safe once wi1 and wi2 land.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4. Implement selectInitialWindow(input, transcript?, budget?), selectPageBefore(input, before, limit, transcript?), selectResumeDelta(input, resume, transcript) and transcriptIdOf(stats) exactly as the PRD algorithm states: merge messages (kindRank 0) and workLog (kindRank 1) by compareTimelineKeys; walk from the newest; count timeline rows (each message is a row, a run of consecutive work entries is one row); measure Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(projected entry)) with projectWorkLogEntry; stop before exceeding maxRows/limit or CONVERSATION_WINDOW_MAX_BYTES except the first entry; cursor = oldest taken entry's encoded key; hasOlder = an older untaken entry exists; initial window adds up to 10 newest pinned open tools (workLog entries with tone 'tool' and !hasToolResult) without moving the cursor; split back into ascending arrays. selectResumeDelta returns entries with sequence > afterSequence plus the server's current copy of every openIds entry, or null on transcript mismatch, missing numeric sequence, afterSequence above the max sequence, or delta over the byte budget.

items.title: Given 300 alternating message and tool entries, selectInitialWindow returns entries covering exactly 75 timeline rows, window.hasOlder true, and window.cursor equal to the encoded key of the oldest returned entry.
Given entries of 200 KB each, selectInitialWindow stops before the encoded entries exceed 983,040 bytes; given one 2 MB message, it returns exactly that message.
Given repeated selectPageBefore calls from the initial window's cursor until hasOlder is false, the concatenated results contain every input id exactly once.
Given a pinned open tool older than the window, selectInitialWindow returns it while window.cursor still points at the oldest contiguous entry.

selectResumeDelta returns only entries newer than afterSequence plus the current copy of each openIds entry for a matching transcript, and returns null for a different transcript id or for entries without a numeric sequence.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-5. Add options {mode: 'window'|'all'|'page', before?, limit?} to getConversationMessagesRead (default 'window'). 'all' returns today's body unchanged. 'page' returns only {messages, workLog, window} from selectPageBefore and skips updateConversationCost. Empty/missing-transcript branches keep their bodies. The route parses window/before/limit from the URL: bad cursor -> 400 {error:'Invalid cursor'}; limit NaN -> 75, clamped to [1,200]; window=all -> mode 'all'; agentId combines with every mode.
